contract: Outcome 2 layer 1 (entry >=95%) + ops-chain observer bound (<=1.5x off)

defended.stack: earlyoom -m 10 + admin_reserve 128MB + swappiness 10 + oom_score shields + pressure gate + gateway v2
defended.alerts: CPU 98.1% CRITICAL [16e944b9], mem 0.8% CRITICAL + swap 100% CRITICAL [f10ee2c0], gate degraded-mode [496dca81] - all delivered in-window

baseline.stack: OFF: earlyoom stopped, admin_reserve 8MB, swappiness 60, guardian off (sshd -1000 retained)

comparison.entry_rate: 8/20 (40%) vs 19/20 (95%) - 2.4x gap; pass line met only with the stack
comparison.psi_mem_full: 45.3 vs 9.9 - the grind the stack removes
comparison.note: undefended triple form lands BELOW the memory-only baseline (52.5%): pageouts compete with the fdatasync storm for the same disk bandwidth, deepening the swap-grind lockout

verdicts.layer1_entry: PASS at the line (95% both runs, defended)
verdicts.host_survival: PASS (no down in either arm; full recovery after cleanup)
verdicts.alerting_liveness: PASS (CRITICAL for all three resources + gate-mode delivered)

defects.what: earlyoom vs respawn-style pressure: dd loop respawned after each kill; 119 earlyoom kills in one window were all dd
defects.disposition: not a product defect - earlyoom does not address respawn sources; recorded as target-3 requirement (identify respawn-type pressure source, prompt loop-breaking)

defects.what: kernel OOM killed UID-1000 user systemd (oom_score_adj=100, WSL default) while hogs (adj 0) were alive
defects.disposition: FIXED: user@.service drop-in OOMScoreAdjust=0; verified live adj 100->0; control-plane shields unchanged

product_decision: The memory-only defense stack covers the lethal axis of the triple form (only memory reaches PSI-full; CPU/IO queue but never block). No CPU- or disk-side component needed for entry capability. Triple form added to the reusable pressure kit.
